statement: The function returns a result r. Call an integer s admissible if 0 <= s, s + k <= len(nums), and the values nums[s], nums[s+1], ..., nums[s+k-1] contain at least m distinct integers. If no admissible s exists, then r = 0. If at least one admissible s exists, then r is the maximum over all admissible s of the sum nums[s] + nums[s+1] + ... + nums[s+k-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 2 * 10^4; 1 <= m <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9. Interpret m and k as their nonnegative integer values.
